name: Dinoflagellates
description: Large, motile algae with two flagella. Functional group pooling the five dinoflagellate taxa in the source web - Glenodinium quadridens and four Peridinium species (P. cinctum, P. limbatum, P. pulsillum and P. wisconsinense) - following the major phytoplankton classes used by the limnological literature.
